title: GPT-5 just leaked and it's terrifying

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you hear? GPT-5 just leaked — and it’s way more powerful than we imagined.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This isn’t just another AI update — it’s a game-changer for everyone.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: GPT-5 is the next-gen language model with 10x more parameters than GPT-4.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It can write code, create art, and even mimic human voices perfectly.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects businesses, educators, and creators — some will be left behind.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? AI is evolving faster than we can keep up.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What do you think — are we ready for this kind of power?

caption_text: GPT-5 just leaked and it's terrifying
